name: Planspector
tagline: Browser-based workspace for reviewing, measuring and comparing construction drawings.
bestFor: Teams that review, mark up and measure PDF drawing sets in the browser
description: Planspector is a browser-based workspace for construction drawings: PDF markup and review, quantity takeoff, revision compare and overlays, drawing checks, and punch lists, RFIs and submittals pinned to the drawings. It is built for contractors, subcontractors, designers and the clients and consultants who review with them.
pros: Free plan with no time limit (3 editors, 10 viewers, 3 projects)
Runs in any modern browser with nothing to install, and works offline
Markup, takeoff, revision compare and punch lists in one tool; viewers are free on paid plans
cons: In early access: sign-up is by request
Works with PDF drawings only; no DWG, RVT or IFC support is listed
No named third-party integrations yet (webhooks only)
freePlanDetails: 3 editors, 10 viewers, 3 projects, 2 GB storage, every drawing and field tool, no time limit.
trial: 14 days of the Business plan for new organisations

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Per editor, billed yearly. Unlimited projects and free viewers, 100 GB storage, restricted projects, webhooks. Monthly billing is offered but its price is not shown.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per editor, billed yearly. Adds single sign-on (OpenID Connect), audit log and 1 TB storage.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing for about 25 users and up; custom limits, invoice billing and self-hosting.

integrations: Webhooks; exports to PDF, CSV and Excel
